summary: Onfolio Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary Eastern Standard, LLC, as maker, and Onfolio as guarantor, entered an October 12, 2026 forbearance agreement with Eastern Standard, LLC (Pennsylvania) as payee on an $850,000 promissory note issued in connection with Onfolio's earlier acquisition of the Eastern Standard business. The note is in payment default; the agreement requires a $450,000 initial payment by October 31, 2026, then $60,000 monthly from December 1, 2026, and a final $45,754.29 payment on July 1, 2027, totaling $915,754.29 inclusive of principal, interest, a $20,000 late charge and other amounts. The payee forbears remedies while payments are timely, subject to a ten-day cure; maturity is not extended and default interest continues to accrue. This is a credit forbearance, not a special situation.
